title:
What is the percentage of incredibly powerful cards in the set Coldsnap?

question:
What is the percentage of incredibly powerful cards in the set Coldsnap?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'; foil is incredibly powerful refers to cardKingdomFoilId is not null AND cardKingdomId is not null; the percentage of incredibly powerful cards in the set refers to DIVIDE(SUM(incredibly powerful), SUM(name = 'Coldsnap'))*100
